Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly shifted from the 1963 film to the TV series, asserting that the director was František Filip and citing Písek as birthplace. This conflated the TV series (with multiple directors, notably František Filip) with the 1963 film, which IMDb clearly credits to Josef Mach—whose birthplace is Prostějov. This misidentification would lead to the wrong birthplace.
